sections.title: What are Large Language Models?
bullets: LLMs are advanced neural networks for text processing
They use self-supervised learning on large text datasets
Popular examples include ChatGPT with billions of parameters

sections.title: How LLMs Process Text
bullets: Input text is tokenized into words or characters
Tokens are converted into embeddings for meaning
Semantic relationships are captured in these embeddings

sections.title: Importance of Prompt Engineering
bullets: Prompt quality affects LLM output accuracy
Small changes in prompts can lead to big differences
Effective prompts guide LLMs to desired outputs

sections.title: Techniques to Enhance Performance
bullets: Automatic Prompt Engineer generates task-specific instructions
Active Prompting selects examples to boost accuracy

sections.title: Challenges and Solutions
bullets: Hallucinations can mislead users in education
Generic strategies may not address specific needs
New tools aim to refine prompts and reduce errors
